# Bare children handed to a component built at run time render, per copy, in
# the caller's scope -- executed rather than read.
#
# testdata/runtime_instance_bare_children.txtar shows what html, fyne and gtk4
# emit for the shape. What a golden cannot show is that each card holds the
# item at its own position, and that adding an item renders a card that holds
# its content. Both are asked here of the running program.
#
# `mounted` is how a target with no DOM to read says it: the effect is part of
# the children, so it mounts once per card and reads the loop variable where
# the card was written. "ab" is two cards each built with its own item, and
# "abc" after the click is the third one built with "c" -- and not, say, the
# second rebuilt, which would read "abb" or "abbc". On html the snapshot is the
# DOM Chromium built, and each `item x` sits inside its own card, after that
# card's own button.
#
# The recursive and forwarded cases are read off the DOM on html only; on fyne
# and gtk4 they are asserted to build, mount and deepen the recursion twice.
# On gtk4 each record holds a reference on its root: a render slot removes
# every entry before appending what it keeps, and the root of a reused
# instance, parented by nothing else, was freed and appended afterwards --
# GTK CRITICALs on every run, and a hang in gtk_box_append on some.
#
# bubbletea is not here: it splices the component rather than building it at
# run time, and refuses an effect that reads a loop variable it does not bind.
#
# Confirmed by reverting: without passInstanceSlots every target below fails to
# build the program, panicking on an *ir.SlotInst in irwalk.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '<button><span>hit 0</span></button><span>item a</span></div></div><div style="display: contents;"><div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column"><button><span>hit 0</span></button><span>item b</span></div></div><div style="display: contents;"><div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column"><button><span>hit 0</span></button><span>item c</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/cards.html

# A recursive component handing its own children down is built at run time as
# a cycle member, and its copy meets its own site again. Each level shows what
# the level above it handed it, and deepening the recursion adds one.
sngl test --platform=html rec.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '<span>top</span>.*<span>level 3</span>.*<span>level 2</span>.*<span>level 1</span>' rec.sngl.snapshots/levels.html

# Two callers handing one component different content, which it forwards to
# another component built at run time -- directly, and down its own recursion.
# Each caller's cards and levels show that caller's children. A copy shared
# between the two showed ALPHA in BETA's row and below BETA's top level.
sngl test --platform=html fwd.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)<span>ALPHA a</span>.*<span>ALPHA a</span>.*<span>BETA</span>.*<span>BETA</span>' fwd.sngl.snapshots/forwarded.html
sngl test --platform=html recfwd.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '<span>BETA</span><span[^A]*<span>BETA</span><span[^A]*<span>BETA</span>' recfwd.sngl.snapshots/levels.html

sngl test --platform=fyne nosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne recnosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne nestnosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'

[!gtk4] stop 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 nosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'
! stderr 'CRITICAL'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 recnosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'
! stderr 'CRITICAL'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 nestnosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'
! stderr 'CRITICAL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Card(children ...component) node {
    var hits = 0

    vbox {
        button(text="hit {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        children
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var mounted = ""

    vbox {
        button #add(text="add", @click { items.push("c") })
        for var it = items {
            Card {
                text(value="item {it}")
                effect(@mount { mounted = mounted + it })
            }
        }
    }
}

func testChildrenRenderPerCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.mounted == "ab")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.mounted == "abc")
    t.snapshot("cards")
}

window {
    main
}
-- nosnap.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component Card(children ...component) node {
    var hits = 0

    vbox {
        button(text="hit {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        children
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var mounted = ""

    vbox {
        button #add(text="add", @click { items.push("c") })
        for var it = items {
            Card {
                text(value="item {it}")
                effect(@mount { mounted = mounted + it })
            }
        }
    }
}

func testChildrenRenderPerCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.mounted == "ab")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.mounted == "abc")
}

window {
    main
}
-- rec.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component frame(n int, content ...component node) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                text(value="level {n}")
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            text(value="top")
        }
        button #deeper(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
    }
}

func testDeepening(t Test, c main) {
    c.deeper.click()
    t.snapshot("levels")
}

window {
    main
}
-- recnosnap.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component frame(n int, content ...component node) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                text(value="level {n}")
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            text(value="top")
        }
        button #deeper(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
    }
}

func testDeepening(t Test, c main) {
    c.deeper.click()
    c.deeper.click()
    t.assert(c.depth == 4)
}

window {
    main
}
-- fwd.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Card(children ...component) node {
    var hits = 0

    vbox {
        children
    }
}

component Row(item list[component node]) node {
    var ks = [1, 2]

    hbox {
        for var k = ks {
            Card {
                item {}
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a"]

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Row {
                component item {
                    text(value="ALPHA {it}")
                }
            }
        }
        for var it = items {
            Row {
                component item {
                    text(value="BETA")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testForwarded(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("forwarded")
}

window {
    main
}
-- recfwd.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component frame(n int, content list[component node]) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content {}
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component content {
                    content {}
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            component content {
                text(value="ALPHA")
            }
        }
        frame(n=depth) {
            component content {
                text(value="BETA")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testForwardedDown(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("levels")
}

window {
    main
}
-- nestnosnap.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component Card(children ...component) node {
    var hits = 0

    vbox {
        button(text="hit {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        children
    }
}

component Row(item list[component node]) node {
    var ks = [1, 2]

    hbox {
        button(text="more", @click { ks.push(3) })
        for var k = ks {
            Card {
                item {}
            }
        }
    }
}

component frame(n int, content list[component node]) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content {}
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component content {
                    content {}
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Row {
                component item {
                    text(value="ALPHA {it}")
                }
            }
        }
        for var it = items {
            Row {
                component item {
                    button(text="BETA")
                }
            }
        }
        frame(n=depth) {
            component content {
                text(value="ALPHA")
            }
        }
        frame(n=depth) {
            component content {
                text(value="BETA")
            }
        }
        button #deeper(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
    }
}

func testNested(t Test, c main) {
    c.deeper.click()
    c.deeper.click()
    t.assert(c.depth == 4)
}

window {
    main
}
